نمتاز (form VIII)
# نَمْتَازُ (namtāzu) /nam.taː.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَازَ (imtāza)
# نَمْتَازَ (namtāza) /nam.taː.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَازَ (imtāza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
